73417-the-great-indian-epics.title: The Great Indian Epics
73417-the-great-indian-epics.creator: Unknown
73417-the-great-indian-epics.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Once every year, at the great festival known as the _Dasahra_, the story of the famous Hindu epic, the “Ramayana,” is, throughout Northern India, recalled to popular memory, by a great out-door dramatic representation of the principal and crowning events in the life of the hero, Rama.

arxiv-1812-01596.title: Gravitational Thermodynamics of Causal Diamonds in (A)dS
arxiv-1812-01596.creator: Ted Jacobson, Manus Visser
arxiv-1812-01596.description: Abstract The static patch of de Sitter spacetime and the Rindler wedge of Minkowski spacetime are causal diamonds admitting a true Killing field, and they behave as thermodynamic equilibrium states under gravitational perturbations. We explore the extension of this gravitational thermodynamics to all causal diamonds in maximally symmetric spacetimes.

arxiv-2202-10437.title: Discovering Affinity Relationships between Personality Types
arxiv-2202-10437.creator: Jean Marie Tshimula, Belkacem Chikhaoui, Shengrui Wang
arxiv-2202-10437.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jean Marie Tshimula, Belkacem Chikhaoui, Shengrui Wang. Psychology research findings suggest that personality is related to differences in friendship characteristics and that some personality traits correlate with linguistic behavior. In this paper, we investigate the influence that personality may have on affinity formation.

arxiv-2207-09319.title: Offline-verifiable Data from Distributed Ledger-based Registries
arxiv-2207-09319.creator: Stefan More 1 , Jakob Heher 1 , Clemens Walluschek 1 1 Institute of Applied Information Processing and Communications (IAIK), Graz University of Technology, Graz, Austria { stefan.more, jakob.heher } @iaik.tugraz.at, official.avocari@gmail.com
arxiv-2207-09319.description: Abstract Trust management systems often use registries to authenticate data, or form trust decisions. Examples are revocation registries and trust status lists. By introducing distributed ledgers (DLs), it is also possible to create decentralized registries. A verifier then queries a node of the respective ledger, e.g., to retrieve trust status information during the verification of a credential.

arxiv-2212-06631.title: Hypocoercivity in algebraically constrained partial differential equations with application to Oseen equations
arxiv-2212-06631.creator: Franz Achleitner, Anton Arnold, Volker Mehrmann
arxiv-2212-06631.description: Abstract The long-time behavior of solutions to different versions of Oseen equations of fluid flow on the 2D torus is analyzed using the concept of hypocoercivity. The considered models are isotropic Oseen equations where the viscosity acts uniformly in all directions and anisotropic Oseen-type equations with different viscosity directions.

arxiv-2303-03976.title: FRA – A new Fast, Robust and Automated pipeline for the detection and measurement of solar-like oscillations in time-series photometry of red-giant stars Publication type: Article Type
arxiv-2303-03976.creator: C. Gehan*, T. L. Campante, M. S. Cunha, F. Pereira
arxiv-2303-03976.description: Abstract We developed, tested and validated a new Fast, Robust and Automated (FRA) tool to detect solar-like pulsations. FRA is based on the detection and measurement of the frequency of maximum oscillation power ν max \nu_{\mathrm{max}} , independently from the large frequency separation Δ ​ ν \Delta\nu .

arxiv-2309-07633.title: Evolutionary-Based Online Motion Planning Framework for Quadruped Robot Jumping
arxiv-2309-07633.creator: Linzhu Yue, Zhitao Song, Hongbo Zhang, Xuanqi Zeng, Lingwei Zhang, Yun-Hui Liu
arxiv-2309-07633.description: Abstract Offline evolutionary-based methodologies have supplied a successful motion planning framework for the quadrupedal jump. However, the time-consuming computation caused by massive population evolution in offline evolutionary-based jumping framework significantly limits the popularity in the quadrupedal field. This paper presents a time-friendly online motion planning framework based on meta-heuristic Differential evolution (DE), Latin hypercube sampling, and Configuration space (DLC).

arxiv-2407-10823.title: VVVX survey dusts off a new intermediate-age star cluster in the Milky Way disk
arxiv-2407-10823.creator: E. R. Garro, D. Minniti, J. Alonso-García, J. G. Fernández-Trincado, M. Gómez, T. Palma, R. K. Saito, C. Obasi
arxiv-2407-10823.description: Abstract Context. In the last decade, many new star clusters have been discovered in heavily obscured regions of the Milky Way bulge and disk. Aims. Our primary long-term objective is to seek out additional star clusters in the poorly studied regions of the Milky Way, where detections pose significant challenges.

arxiv-2409-19318.title: Fairness Analysis with Shapley-Owen Effects
arxiv-2409-19318.creator: H arald Ruess
arxiv-2409-19318.description: Abstract We argue that relative importance and its equitable attribution in terms of Shapley-Owen effects is an appropriate one, and, if we accept a small number of reasonable imperatives for equitable attribution, the only way to measure fairness. On the other hand, the computation of Shapley-Owen effects can be very demanding.

arxiv-2411-07488.title: Selling an Item through Persuasion
arxiv-2411-07488.creator: Zhikang Fan, Weiran Shen
arxiv-2411-07488.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhikang Fan, Weiran Shen. A monopolistic seller aims to sell an indivisible item to multiple potential buyers. Each buyer’s valuation depends on their private type and the item’s quality. The seller can observe the quality but it is unknown to buyers. This quality information is valuable to buyers, so it is beneficial for the seller to strategically design experiments that reveal information about the quality before deciding to sell the item to whom and at what price.

arxiv-2502-01498.title: Compact Yet Highly Accurate Printed Classifiers Using Sequential Support Vector Machine Circuits
arxiv-2502-01498.creator: Ilias Sertaridis, Spyridon Besias, Florentia Afentaki, Konstantinos Balaskas and Georgios Zervakis
arxiv-2502-01498.description: Abstract Printed Electronics (PE) technology has emerged as a promising alternative to silicon-based computing. It offers attractive properties such as on-demand ultra-low-cost fabrication, mechanical flexibility, and conformality. However, PE are governed by large feature sizes, prohibiting the realization of complex printed Machine Learning (ML) classifiers.

arxiv-2505-03518.title: High-order exponential solver method for particle-in-cell simulations
arxiv-2505-03518.creator: Szilárd Majorosi, Nasr A.M. Hafz, Zsolt Lécz
arxiv-2505-03518.description: Abstract Outstanding advances in solid-state laser technology, employing the optical parametric chirped-pulse-amplification (OPCPA) technique, have led physicists to focus laser pulses to highly- relativistic intensities which led to novel schemes for charged-particle acceleration and radiation generation in laser-driven plasmas. Microscopic understanding of these highly-nonlinear processes is possible via accurate modeling of the laser-plasma interaction using particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations.

arxiv-2506-21438.title: Spin-orbit interaction, band topology, and spin texture in BiInO 3 {}_{\text{3}} (001) surface
arxiv-2506-21438.creator: Ramsamoj Kewat, Nirmal Ganguli
arxiv-2506-21438.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ramsamoj Kewat, Nirmal Ganguli. This research investigates the implication of spin-orbit interaction (SOI) and symmetry on the band topology and spin texture at the (001) surface of BiInO 3 . Using density functional theory (DFT) and symmetry analysis, the study explores the impact of surface termination on the electronic structure, particularly focusing on how the loss of translational symmetry at the surface influences the band topology of the surface states.

arxiv-2511-23072.title: What If They Took the Shot? A Hierarchical Bayesian Framework for Counterfactual Expected Goals Journal: XXXX
arxiv-2511-23072.creator: Mikayil Mahmudlu, Oktay Karakuş, Hasan Arkadaş
arxiv-2511-23072.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mikayil Mahmudlu, Oktay Karakuş, Hasan Arkadaş. This study develops a hierarchical Bayesian framework that integrates expert domain knowledge to quantify player-specific effects in expected goals (xG) estimation, addressing a core limitation of traditional models that treat all players as identical finishers. Using 9,970 shots from StatsBomb’s 2015–16 dataset and expert ratings from Football Manager 2017, we combine Bayesian logistic regression with FM-informed priors to stabilise player-level estimates, particularly for individuals with limited shot histories.

pmc-10685020.title: Cardioprotective study of Eriobotrya japonica leaf extracts against carbon tetrachloride induced toxicity in rats
pmc-10685020.creator: Abdelaaty A Shahat, Riaz Ullah, Ali S Alqahtani, Omer I Fantoukh
pmc-10685020.description: The Rosaceae family includes the evergreen subtropical tree known as Eriobotrya japonica Lindl (loquat). To test the effect of several E. japonica leaf extracts on shielding the heart from carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) cytotoxic effects, we employed carbon tetrachloride (CCl4), a highly toxic chemical, to cause cardiotoxicity in rats.

pmc-11715218.title: TDP‐43 association with Subiculum and CA1 Hippocampal Subfield Atrophy in Primary Age‐Related Tauopathy
pmc-11715218.creator: Hossam Youssef, Rodolfo G Gatto, Nha Trang Thu Pham, Ronald C Petersen, Mary M Machulda, Ross R Reichard, Dennis W Dickson, Clifford R Jack, Jennifer L Whitwell, Keith A Josephs
pmc-11715218.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe TAR DNA‐binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP‐43) is linked to hippocampal volume loss and faster rates of hippocampal atrophy in Alzheimer's disease and primary age‐related tauopathy (PART). Hence, TDP‐43 is becoming an important player in age‐related neurodegeneration.

pmc-12512548.title: Optimizing myopia screening referral guidelines for children aged 4 to 18 based on non-cycloplegic indicators
pmc-12512548.creator: Pingping Lyu, Jiaojiao Shi, Jingjing Wang, Xiangui He, Huijing Shi
pmc-12512548.description: BackgroundTo evaluate the stability and predictive ability of uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), non-cycloplegic refraction (NCR), and axial length (AL) as indicators in non-cycloplegic school vision screening for myopia.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study is based on the Shanghai Child and Adolescent Large-scale Eye Study (SCALE).

pmc-12588947.title: Determinants of delayed healthcare seeking among STI patients in Eastern Ethiopia: a case-control study
pmc-12588947.creator: Dereje Bifa, Delelegn Yilma, Tsegaye Banti, Lechisa Asefa
pmc-12588947.description: BackgroundDelayed healthcare seeking is one of the major impediments to successfully preventing and controlling sexually transmitted infections. A delay in healthcare seeking prolongs the period of infectiousness and increases the incidence of sexually transmitted diseases. The majority of sexually transmitted infections are curable, but several social and behavioral factors hinder people from seeking early healthcare.

pmc-13010544.title: Efficacy and safety of semirigid ureterolithotripsy in pediatric urolithiasis: Retrospective analysis from a tertiary center
pmc-13010544.creator: Ulugbek Khudaybergenov, Azizbek Shomarufov, Olimjon Abdukarimov, Yalkin Nadjimitdinov
pmc-13010544.description: BACKGROUNDEndoscopic ureterolithotripsy (EUL) is a minimally invasive and effective treatment for pediatric ureteral stones, offering high success rates while addressing anatomical challenges unique to children.AIMTo evaluate the success and safety of EUL in pediatric patients, focusing on lithotripsy technique, stone location, and patient-specific variables.METHODSA retrospective analysis was performed on 250 children treated with EUL from 2015 to 2022.

pmc-13465162.title: Predictive value of frailty indices for postoperative outcomes of metastatic spine tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13465162.creator: Hai-bo Xie, Ling-shan Fan, Qi Zhang, Xiao-yu Zhang, Si Wu, Xiao-qing Zhang, Kang-jian Li, Ai-feng Liu
pmc-13465162.description: Surgical management of spinal metastases aims to palliate symptoms but poses significant perioperative risks. Traditional tools like survival scores and comorbidity indices inadequately capture the multidimensional frailty in cancer patients, prompting interest in frailty indices for risk stratification. This meta-analysis evaluates the predictive value of frailty indices for postoperative outcomes in spinal metastasis surgery.
